methodology.measure: Fame is the share of surveyed U.S. adults who have heard of the entity.
methodology.sampleBoundary: YouGov survey percentage; not unique viewers, buyers, or a commercial-use license.
methodology.coverageBoundary: The universe contains YouGov entertainment entities at or above the 100M adult-population-equivalent threshold; it is broad survey coverage, not every entertainment work ever created.
methodology.equivalentBoundary: Survey percentage multiplied by the 2020 adult population. This is an estimate, not a directly measured audience count.
